plan: Given the prize value of $47, my goal is to bid just above the expected third-highest bid to maximize profit. Since all bidders are rational, they will bid close to their values. However, to ensure winning, bidding $47 maximizes the chance of winning while ensuring no loss if the third-highest bid is below $47.
